answer: A shared liveness clock lets one operator animate many aliases. The applicant commits a prism = ripemd160(pubkey||facet_salt)[:12] and escrows 23 POA for 5 epochs. A gale index, slot k=(salt xor height xor 19*k) mod roster, picks four unaffiliated keepers 8h apart over 32h, kin skipped. Each keeper must record a signed pulse = hmac-sha256(prism||keeper_pk||nonce_k) in a 25-minute window, fee 0.55 POA. Escrow returns only when all four pulses verify. Peers recompute the index and windows. A reused prism, missed pulse, or shared-host keeper slashes 36% to that keeper and bars the salt 6 epochs.
